theorems.name: Submission.codim1_ac_perturbation_diffeo
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (Z : Euclid P → Euclid P), ContDiff ℝ 1 Z → HasCompactSupport Z → ∃ t₀ : ℝ, 0 < t₀ ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, |t| < t₀ → Bijective (fun x => x + t • Z x) ∧ (∀ x, Injective (fderiv ℝ (fun x => x + t • Z x) x)) ∧ ∃ Λ : NNReal, LipschitzWith Λ (fun x => x + t • Z x) ∧ AntilipschitzWith Λ (fun x => x + t • Z x)
